scope: survey identity joins, response populations, latest-versus-superseded onboarding selection, date ties and truncation totals, repeated-response weighting, nonresponse coverage, warning labels, finite serialization, upload atomicity, active-snapshot provenance and cache disclosure
confirmed_findings_fixed: Onboarding snapshot selection now exposes superseded rows, undated rows and same-date tie rows, and health and trajectory consume the same latest-per-employee-and-survey-type population.
Trajectory totals are computed before the ten-row presentation limit and the API reports total, returned and truncated counts.
eNPS remains explicitly response-weighted rather than silently changing to employee prevalence; unique respondents, repeated rows and exact date-filtered coverage are reported.
Onboarding health and survey-type metrics expose observations and respondent coverage so missing responses are not presented as workforce-wide health.
Low onboarding scores are no longer labelled as declining unless a measured trajectory declines; warning details and schemas state that observed flags are not future-departure predictions.

Sentiment routes now carry verified dataset identity, generation and fingerprint provenance, explicitly report that no result cache is used, and reject a runtime whose active snapshot no longer reconciles with the engine.
Existing atomic survey replacement and finite JSON serialization contracts remain covered by the broader regression suite.
interpretation_boundary: Sentiment and eNPS are observed survey summaries. Early-warning labels are not predictions of departure or evidence of employee intent.
remaining_scientific_limits: Response rates and coverage are descriptive; no nonresponse-bias adjustment, representativeness or instrument validity is established.
eNPS currently weights each valid response equally, so repeated responders can influence results more than once; a different weighting policy requires a governed instrument decision.

Same-date onboarding ties retain the last source row and missing dates sort oldest; source systems should provide a stable response timestamp or immutable response identifier before stronger longitudinal claims.
Warning thresholds and severity are configured heuristics over observed survey responses, not validated departure risk, employee intent, causal drivers or employment-decision evidence.

Dataset fingerprint reconciliation covers the active workforce snapshot; survey-file lineage, survey instrument versions and external cache invalidation are not independently authenticated by this cycle.

cross_product_validation.full_python_validation: 1183_passed_7_failed_before_final_compatibility_correction; five unrelated concurrent-lane failures remain after the two sentiment-shape failures were corrected

release_gate: GO for bounded observed survey reporting only when verified dataset provenance is present; NO-GO for future-departure, causal, representative-population or employment-decision claims.
